entities.summary: Zhang Pengxiang  is a chess grandmaster of Chinese ethnicity, and the 2007 Asian Chess Champion. In 2001, he became China's 12th Grandmaster. Zhang's peak rating was 2657 in April 2007 when he was ranked 47th in the world.
